title: Not worth the price
text:
Extremely average candy for a high price. I don't see the "value" in around $5 or more per little jar for "nothing special" random candy, and no option to pick what you want to try! I liked another subscription box that allowed me to pick out my treats every month. Candy Club should have a choice between picking out your own things each month, or check a "surprise me!" option to get the random candies. I ended up with Mike chocolate, which I don't care for, strawberry banana gummy bears (ew), a couple good things, and sorta stale caramel popcorn. And I spent almost $30 for it.

Save your money and just go to a candy store. At least these little jars are cute, though.
label: neutral
